notes.title: Destiny Spire Demo Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]It took us a little longer than we originally planned but the demo is now available! We took the extra time to add some extra mechanics like dungeon maps, and the trait system, which will give your party of characters more customization.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo features the first 2 dungeons and comprises what is sort of the prologue of the game. The Great Plateau of the game if you will. The game basically opens up in 4 chunks, with each chunk becoming larger and more open ended, this demo area is that first chunk.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo should take anywhere from 1-2 hours to complete depending how lost you get (or faster if you want to memorize and speed run it ːsteamhappyː)[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the demo![/p]
